structures.label: Rectus femoris
structures.description: Central quadriceps muscle; here it includes the patellar tendon to the tibia.
structures.function: Straightens the knee and flexes the hip.

structures.label: Vastus lateralis
structures.description: Largest quadriceps head, on the outer thigh.

structures.label: Vastus medialis
structures.description: Inner quadriceps head forming the teardrop above the knee.
structures.function: Straightens the knee and helps keep the kneecap on track.

structures.label: Semitendinosus & semimembranosus
structures.description: Inner hamstrings, from the sitting bone to the inner tibia.
structures.function: Bend the knee, extend the hip and rotate the shin inwards.

structures.label: Biceps femoris
structures.description: Outer hamstring, inserting on the head of the fibula.
structures.function: Bends the knee, extends the hip and rotates the shin outwards.

structures.label: Gastrocnemius
structures.description: Two-headed calf muscle arising just above the knee.
structures.function: Points the foot and helps bend the knee.

structures.label: Iliotibial band
structures.description: Thick band of fascia on the outer thigh ending at the tibia.
structures.function: Stabilises the outer knee; irritated in runner's knee (ITB syndrome).

structures.label: Vastus intermedius
structures.description: Quadriceps head lying directly on the femur under the rectus femoris.

structures.label: Popliteus
structures.description: Small deep muscle behind the knee.
structures.function: "Unlocks" the straight knee by rotating the tibia inwards.

structures.label: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL)
structures.description: Ligament crossing inside the knee from the femur to the front of the tibia.
structures.function: Stops the shin sliding forwards and controls rotation; often torn when pivoting.

structures.label: Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL)
structures.description: Thickest knee ligament, crossing behind the ACL.

structures.label: Medial collateral ligament (MCL)
structures.description: Broad ligament on the inner side of the knee.
structures.function: Resists the knee buckling inwards (valgus); the most commonly sprained knee ligament.

structures.label: Lateral collateral ligament (LCL)
structures.description: Cord-like ligament from the femur to the fibula.

structures.label: Medial meniscus
structures.description: C-shaped cartilage cushion on the inner tibia.
structures.function: Absorbs shock and spreads load; torn more often than the lateral one.

structures.label: Lateral meniscus
structures.description: O-shaped cartilage cushion on the outer tibia.
structures.function: Absorbs shock and improves the fit of the joint.

structures.label: Femur (distal)
structures.description: Thigh bone; its lower end forms the two condyles.
structures.function: Upper surface of the knee joint.

structures.label: Patella
structures.description: Kneecap, a sesamoid bone inside the quadriceps tendon.
structures.function: Increases the leverage of the quadriceps by up to 30%.

structures.label: Tibia
structures.description: Shin bone; its flat top carries the menisci.
structures.function: Main weight-bearing bone of the lower leg.

structures.label: Fibula
structures.description: Thin outer bone of the lower leg.
structures.function: Attachment for the LCL and biceps femoris; bears little weight.
